name: A ghost released in Dunshire finds the Spirit Healer (#8136)

stands by the gravestones at -7736.53 600.03 as placed in game (#8376). A character who dies in Dunshire and
releases appears within a few yards of it, not on the bridge 83 yd north where it stood before.
